---
title: "05_Deconvolution_Preparation"
subtitle: "TMM normalisation and RUV4 correction keeping the negative probes (input for spatialDecon)"
author: "Luca Mastrantoni"
output: html_document
---

Input: `OUTPUT/rds/target_demoData.rds` (01)  
Output: `OUTPUT/rds/spe_ruv_d.rds`

Same steps as 03_Batch_Correction, but the negative probe is kept because
`prepareSpatialDecon` uses it to estimate the background.

```{r setup, message=FALSE}
source("Setup.R")
```

```{r}
target_demoData <- readRDS(file.path(path_rds, "target_demoData.rds"))

spe <- geomx_to_spe(target_demoData, rmNegProbe = FALSE)
spe <- add_sample_labels(spe)
```

```{r}
spe <- geomxNorm(spe, method = "TMM")
spe <- findNCGs(spe, batch_name = "Scan", top_n = 300)
spe_ruv <- geomxBatchCorrection(spe, factors = c("biology"), NCGs = metadata(spe)$NCGs, k = 3)
```

```{r}
saveRDS(spe_ruv, file = file.path(path_rds, "spe_ruv_d.rds"))
```
